query: Illumination Hardware Suite road occupancy changes during the 2024-05-27 to 2024-05-29 forecast horizon

evidence.claim: Memorial Day creates a 24-hour non-working regime on May 27 that typically reduces traffic on the Illumination Hardware Suite.
evidence.exact_quote: In accordance with corporate policy, Memorial Day (2024-05-27) is designated as a non-working day. The non-working status of this holiday initiates a shift in the standard operational environment across the sector. Historically, this shift results in a notable reduction in usage of the Illumination Hardware Suite, and traffic on the Illumination Hardware Suite typically reduces on holidays. Consequently, regular site operations are suspended for the duration of the 24-hour period.

evidence.claim: After the holiday, Sector 7-B road occupancy typically returns immediately to its established high weekly level without a ramp-up period.
evidence.exact_quote: Data indicates that road occupancy in this sector typically returns to its established high weekly average immediately following a holiday period. There is no observed ramp-up period; the transition to full capacity is instantaneous once the holiday concludes.

impacts.rationale: The scheduled Memorial Day closure overlaps the first 24 hours of the forecast and invalidates an unchanged local-level assumption, but the document provides no explicit numeric magnitude for the reduction.
Historical monitoring indicates that the temporary holiday regime ends immediately after May 27 and the established high weekly baseline resumes without a gradual recovery.
